title: Daughter of Palo Alto Networks CEO Raises $100M AI Fund
summary:
Ayesha Arora-Hughes is establishing a new venture capital vehicle to invest in early stage companies specializing in artificial intelligence. The fund is targeting at least $100 million in commitments and will provide capital to startups within the AI sector.

Nikesh Arora, the chief executive officer of Palo Alto Networks and father of Arora-Hughes, is serving as an advisor to the fund. He is providing guidance as a seasoned executive and investor to help launch the vehicle in a highly competitive market.
